entries.en: The door is tightly sealed.
The door is locked.
The door seems to be locked[n]from the other side...
The door is now unlocked.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's not opening. Oh well, let's check[n]somewhere else.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We already got the device thing, right?[n]Let's go somewhere else.
entries.uk: Ту штуку-пристрій ми вже отримали, так?[n]Ходімо деінде.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? Hey, where are you going? We set[n]up the cheating device—wouldn't it be[n]kinda bad to leave now?
entries.uk: Га? Гей, ти куди? Ми ж налаштували[n]пристрій для шахрайства — хіба не[n]погано зараз іти?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It would be troublesome if some guest[n]other than ourselves won big. Let's take[n]advantage of the device before we leave.
entries.uk: Буде прикро, якщо великий виграш дістанеться[n]не нам, а іншому гостеві. Скористаймося[n]пристроєм, перш ніж піти.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Woo, we won a lot! That was fun!
entries.uk: Ура, ми стільки виграли! Було весело!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Have we reached our goal?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It still may not be enough.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Are you seriously planning on taking[n]every last coin in here?
entries.uk: Ти що, серйозно хочеш забрати[n]звідси всі жетони до останнього?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Ahaha, it was a joke. However, it would[n]be nice to have a little more coinage on[n]hand, would it not?
entries.uk: Ха-ха, я пожартував. Утім, мати[n]трохи більше жетонів було б[n]непогано, чи не так?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Everyone wait here. Skull, I would like[n]you to come with me.
entries.uk: Усі чекайте тут. Черепе, я хотів би,[n]щоб ти пішов зі мною.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why me?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Because I am the "brains" here, am I not?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Oh, sure.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Time to see what he's made of.
